policy: transitionCurrent: transition_sound: a current transition is unretired, same-epoch, same-owner and open
transitionCurrent: transition_complete: every unretired, same-epoch, same-owner, open transition is current
cleanupState: cleanup_failure_quarantines: a cleanup failure always quarantines
cleanupState: cleanup_diverted: an unfailed diverted cleanup is diverted
cleanupState: cleanup_disposed: an unfailed undiverted cleanup is disposed
unknownConflict: unknown_conflict_exact: an unknown scope conflicts exactly when it or its peer is noncommutative
unknownConflict: unknown_conflict_symmetric: swapping the sides never changes the decision
knownConflict: known_conflict_exact: a shared resource conflicts exactly when one side is ordered
lineageSelected: active_lineage_only: without all-branch selection only members are selected
lineageSelected: explicit_all_lineages: explicit all-branch selection selects every entry
pointerCurrent: pointer_sound: a current pointer matches its source and its lineage
pointerCurrent: pointer_complete: a pointer matching its source and lineage is current
coverageComplete: coverage_sound: complete coverage needs a complete source and no truncation
coverageComplete: coverage_complete: an untruncated complete source is complete coverage
useNormalized: normalization_sound: a normal form is used only for non-canonical, planned, changed, accepted arguments
useNormalized: normalization_complete: every non-canonical, planned, changed, accepted normal form is used
useNormalized: canonical_identity: canonical arguments stay original
headReadable: head_sound: a readable head has its sequence, its version, and a commit or a marked pending write
headReadable: pending_without_marker_hidden: a pending uncommitted head without its marker is hidden
headReadable: committed_head_visible: a committed head with its sequence and version is visible
certificateAccepted: certificate_sound: an accepted certificate has every fact
certificateAccepted: certificate_complete: a certificate with every fact is accepted
consume: consume_once: an inactive token releases nothing
consume: consume_retires: consumption releases an active token and leaves it inactive
summaryWithin: summary_bounds: an accepted summary is within its byte limit and token target
summaryWithin: summary_complete: a summary within both bounds is accepted
sampleWithin: sample_accounting: retained plus omitted is the total, and the retained fit the limit
sampleWithin: sample_complete: exact accounting within the limit is accepted
chunkAccepted: chunk_sound: an accepted chunk starts where expected, has the expected total, an exact length, truthful completion and progress
chunkAccepted: chunk_complete: every chunk meeting those requirements is accepted
compaction: compactionCut: cut_sound: an open cut is eligible, after the previous marker, and within its tail budget; span_sound: a span keeps the cut open only if it was open and the span does not straddle the boundary; refusal_final: a refused cut stays refused; header_once: a header opens only an unstarted cut; cut_complete: a valid header opens a fresh cut, and an allowed span keeps it open
resources: resourceScope: scope names are a set; resource_source_refinement: an exact source keeps every declared name, and only those; resource_source_valid: an exact source is nonempty, with no empty or wildcard identity; resource_source_complete: every nonempty source of valid identities is exact; resource_refinement: normalization keeps a scope's names in both directions or widens it to unknown; resource_output_valid: an exact normal form is nonempty, at most 64 valid names of at most 256 code units; resource_unknown: a refused scope is unknown and names nothing; resource_precision: a valid bounded set-equivalent proposal is accepted as given (so the identity proposal is unchanged); resource_recheck_idempotent: rechecking a normal form against itself keeps it

resourceConflict: resource_pair_sound: quiet effects never conflict, nor do two commutative ones; resource_conflict_exact: exact disjoint scopes never conflict; resource_conflict_complete: an ordered pair of effects with an unknown scope conflicts; resource_pair_complete: an ordered pair of effects sharing a named resource conflicts

resourceGroups: resource_groups_known: independent groups have no ordered pair of effects with an unknown scope; resource_groups_unshared: independent groups have no ordered pair of effects naming one resource; resource_groups_unknown_complete: an ordered pair of effects with an unknown scope makes the groups conflict; resource_groups_shared_complete: an ordered pair of effects naming one resource makes the groups conflict
lifecycle: bindingStep: inspect_safe: a granted inspection is open to ordinary work and changes nothing; every inspection changes nothing; inspect_open_complete: an inspection open to ordinary work is granted; begin_safe: a granted begin was open and adds exactly one call; a denied one changes nothing; begin_open_complete: every open begin is granted with one more call; retain_safe: a granted retain was open and adds exactly one hold; a denied one changes nothing; retain_open_complete: every open retain is granted with one more hold; close_safe: close starts only from a retiring, ownerless, idle binding, into Closing; otherwise nothing changes; close_complete: a retiring, ownerless, idle binding starts closing; release_exact: a release with holds removes exactly one; with none it is refused and changes nothing; end_exact: an end with calls removes exactly one; with none it is refused and changes nothing; revoke_preserves_work: revocation retires, drops the owner and keeps every hold and call; drop_owner_preserves_work: dropping the owner keeps everything else; retire_preserves_work: retirement changes only the phase; activation_exact: Staged and Active activate; every other phase is refused unchanged; completion_exact: Closing completes into Closed; every other phase is refused unchanged; failure_exact: abort quarantines every unclosed binding, keeping its work; Closed is refused unchanged; closing_refuses_work: a closing binding refuses every begin; revoked_refuses_work: a revoked binding refuses ordinary work; cleanup_after_revocation: a revoked retiring binding still admits cleanup
storage: storageTransition: storage_safe: an unchanged plan is an admitted delete of an absent key
storageTransition: storage_safe: a put forwards its key, value and identity exactly, at the successors of its base and of the clock
storageTransition: storage_safe: a delete forwards its key from a present slot, at the successors of its version and of the clock
storageTransition: storage_put_complete: an admitted put with room is written
storageTransition: storage_delete_complete: an admitted delete of a present key with room is applied
storageTransition: storage_absent_delete_complete: an admitted delete of an absent key changes nothing
storageTransition: storage_stale_refused: an expected revision other than the actual one is a conflict
storageTransition: storage_put_overflow: an admitted put without room is exhausted
storageTransition: storage_delete_overflow: an admitted delete of a present key without room is exhausted
provider: providerTicket: provider_plan_safe: a planned write had a live grant for this key, no cancellation and the expected revision, and forwards them exactly; provider_ticket_consumed: taking consumes the ticket and keeps its contents; provider_revocation_consumes: revoking consumes the ticket and plans nothing; provider_revoked_refused: a consumed ticket plans nothing; provider_canceled_refused: a canceled take plans nothing; state_stale_refused: a revision other than the expected one plans nothing; provider_admission_complete: a live ticket taken for its key at its revision plans exactly its write; provider_replay_refused: a second take of the same ticket plans nothing
authority: capabilityAuthority: grants are a set; authority_issue_exact: issuance is live and holds exactly its grants; authority_use_safe: a granted use was live and named a held grant; authority_use_complete: a live use of a held grant is granted; authority_use_preserves: a use changes no authority; authority_derive_safe: a live child had a live parent and holds exactly its candidate, all within the parent; authority_derive_complete: a candidate within a live parent is derived exactly; authority_released_cannot_derive: a released parent derives only a released child; authority_released_not_live: release leaves no live authority and no grants; authority_child_use_safe: a derived child's granted use names a grant of its parent; authority_released_refused: a released authority grants nothing
